latest_release.name: AdGuard Home v0.107.80
latest_release.body:
Being vulnerable is fine, but not when it comes to dependencies. That's why we're making this release with updated dependencies to keep AdGuard Home running smoothly and securely 💪

## Full changelog

See also the [v0.107.80 GitHub milestone][ms-v0.107.80].

### Security

- Go version has been updated to mitigate the possibility of exploiting the Go vulnerabilities fixed in [1.27.3][go-1.27.3].

- Support for Multipath TCP has been disabled to mitigate the possibility of exploiting the vulnerability described in [CVE-2026-98432][cve-2026-98432].

### Removed

- The support for macOS 13 Ventura, see [Go 1.27 release notes][go-1.27-notes].

[cve-2026-98432]: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-98432
[go-1.27-notes]:  https://go.dev/doc/go1.27#darwin
[go-1.27.3]:      https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/66pojueaQek
[ms-v0.107.80]:   https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdGuardHome/milestone/115?closed=1

detail.readme_excerpt:
Privacy protection center for you and your devices

Free and open source, powerful network-wide ads & trackers blocking DNS server.

AdGuard.com | Wiki | Reddit | Twitter | Telegram



AdGuard Home is a network-wide software for blocking ads and tracking. After you set it up, it'll cover ALL your home devices, and you don't need any client-side software for that. It operates as a DNS server that re-routes tracking domains to a “black hole”, thus preventing your devices from connecting to those servers. It's based on software we use for our public [AdGuard DNS] servers, and both share a lot of code.
